learning_outcomes.text: Can perform furnace selection, raw material selection, and alloy adjustment calculations for melting stage processes.
Can make appropriate selections for sand mold materials and cores for the sand mold casting method.
Can design models for the sand mold casting method.
Can design the solidification stage and demolding time for desired properties and defect-free products.
Can evaluate the effects of mold sand recycling on quality and cost.
Knows casting defects and can perform necessary quality control operations.

syllabus_topics: Sand mold casting methods and comparison for method selection
Models and mold cavity model design
Methods other than Sand Mold Casting and casting method selection
Casting defects and Casting part design
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on 50% from in-term success and 50% from the final exam. In-term success is derived from a midterm exam (50%), an assignment (35%), and a quiz (15%).
